name: Pharmulo
oneLiner: Retailers order on their phones. Each order opens as a GST bill, without retyping.
catalogueNote: Give medical shops a way to place orders directly, without calling your team.
detail: Give your retailers an ordering app with your business name. They can check live stock and place orders from their phones. Each order opens as a GST bill. Manage stock, collections and supplier payments in the same system.

screenshot.alt: Pharmulo home page with its ordering app for pharma wholesalers

name: Freight billing system
oneLiner: Lorry receipts, freight bills and payments in one place.
catalogueNote: Connect each lorry receipt to its bill, track payments and send customer statements when needed.
detail: Follow each lorry receipt through billing and payment in one system. Payments are matched to bills, and customers can check their own statements. We first built it for Naveen Logistics, a family-run transport business in Bengaluru that uses it every day.
